name: Spirit of Ivory
ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
interaction: Declared publicly at the start. The Storyteller marks it NO MORE EVIL whenever an extra evil player exists; a player who would become evil then stays good.
drunk_or_poisoned: Fabled cannot be drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: The normal evil count is the one on the setup sheet; only one more is allowed at a time.
The reminder is removed if an extra evil player becomes good, allowing the next conversion.

test_scenarios.name: first conversion allowed
test_scenarios.setup: Spirit of Ivory; Bob Fang Gu, Eve Saint.
test_scenarios.expected: Eve becomes the evil Fang Gu; the Spirit is marked NO MORE EVIL.

test_scenarios.name: second conversion blocked
test_scenarios.setup: Spirit of Ivory; Bob Fang Gu jumped to Eve (extra evil); Carol Goon; Dave Devil's Advocate.

test_scenarios.name: reminder cleared
test_scenarios.setup: Spirit of Ivory marked NO MORE EVIL; the extra evil player is turned good.
test_scenarios.actions: Later another player would turn evil.
